content_of_post_to_answer: How do you know when it’s time to leave your comfort zone and start over?
answer: The hardest part about leaving a comfort zone is that discomfort alone is not a reliable signal. Growth and a wrong path can both feel uncomfortable. A better question is whether your current situation is still helping you become the person you want to be, or whether you are staying because the cost of change feels scarier than the cost of stagnation. Many people don't leave when things become unbearable; they leave when they realize they are slowly becoming someone they no longer recognize. Comfort is valuable, but it becomes a trap when it protects a life you have already outgrown.
